name: ofSupport_support
statement: V} (p : G.Walk u v) : ofSupport _ p.support_ne_nil p.isChain_adj_support = p.copy (by simp) (by simp)

name: mem_darts_reverse
statement: V} {d : G.Dart} {p : G.Walk u v} : d ∈ p.reverse.darts ↔ d.symm ∈ p.darts

name: Nil.eq_copy_nil
statement: G.Walk u v} (h : p.Nil) : p = Walk.nil.copy rfl h.eq

name: ext_getVert_le_length
statement: G.Walk u v} (hl : p.length = q.length) (h : ∀ k ≤ p.length, p.getVert k = q.getVert k) : p = q
